data.name: Mid Evil Nights
data.detailed_description:
When the sun falls, the world changes.

Mid Evil Nights throws you into a dark medieval land where survival is never guaranteed. During the day, you must gather resources, craft equipment, build shelter, and prepare for the dangers ahead. But when night arrives, the creatures of the dark begin to roam, and every wall, weapon, and torch becomes the difference between life and death.

Explore an unforgiving world filled with wilderness, ruins, resources, and secrets. Build a home, turn it into a fortress, and push deeper into the unknown as you uncover the mysteries hiding beneath the surface of this cursed land.

Survive the day. Fear the night. Build your legacy in Mid Evil Nights.

data.short_description: Mid Evil Nights is a dark medieval survival game where you gather resources, craft gear, build shelter, and defend yourself from creatures that emerge after sunset. Explore, prepare, and survive the dangers of each night.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD RX 590
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended.

content_descriptors.notes: Mid Evil Nights contains fantasy violence, combat, and killing. Players can fight hostile creatures and enemies using medieval weapons, tools, and crafted equipment. Combat may include impact effects, enemy death animations, blood or damage effects, and dark fantasy themes. The game does not contain sexual content or nudity.
